# A settlement offer is a gross number. How much would you actually keep?

> Free injury settlement calculator: enter the gross amount, attorney fee, costs and medical liens and see what the client actually takes home, with Medicare's procurement-cost reduction and the effect of negotiating each lien. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
